dex.entry: The cloud-hound's final form — a great silver-and-gold stormhound whose body is a living thunderhead, radiating soft dawn-light even through the Galehigh dusk. A cloud-puppy grew into the living heart of a thunderstorm lit from within by golden light.

art.silhouette: Majestic hound silhouette, body a sculptured mass of dark-silver cloud, a blazing golden core visible through the chest, mane of vertical lightning-columns, four cloud-pad legs leaving gold hoofprints; awe-inspiring at 64px.
